company.name: Foxpass
company.shortDescription: Foxpass brings enterprise-level security practices to companies of all sizes.
company.description:
Foxpass increases your organization's server and network security by ensuring employee accounts have access only to what they need.

Their cloud-hosted LDAP, RADIUS, and server access control systems help you bring best practices to your infrastructure. And they're backed by your existing Google Apps or Office 365 accounts.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-hosted RADIUS server providing authentication, authorization, and accounting services for network access control.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-hosted LDAP server that centralizes directory and authentication data for user and device management.

productsAndServices.description: A system to manage SSH keys for secure access to servers, including key rotation and policy enforcement.
productsAndServices.name: SSH Key Management

productsAndServices.description: An authentication framework using 802.1X and RADIUS to secure Wi-Fi access with per-user credentials and certificate-based methods.

productsAndServices.name: Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) Endpoint

productsAndServices.description: A protocol that secures RADIUS communication by transmitting data over TLS-encrypted channels.
productsAndServices.name: RadSec (RADIUS over TLS)
